scope: Separate positional and rotational contributions; measure training loss concentration before selecting one fixed next loss experiment
diagnostics: All training cohorts: raw position and trajectory loss using group-excluded v20 expert and current fitted gate; identify relative objective contribution. Gate diagnostics are in-sample.
All exposed old/new validation: projected linear/Hermite/shape positions each paired with frozen v20 rotations. No model fit, sample selection, gate alteration or confirmation access.
gates_policy: Original frozen development gates unchanged; ablations are diagnostic learned/procedural combinations, not new independent validation or pure procedural controls.
next: Specify one candidate only after diagnostics, using training-only normalization estimates; no validation-based grid or threshold edits.
